description: Get detailed information about a specific trip. The text response includes the trip summary plus a chronological list of every segment (flights, hotels, activities, etc.) with each segment_id, so you can chain directly to segment_details, segment_update, segment_delete, or flight_status_for_segment without another search. Also includes traveler count. For full per-segment details, use segment_details with the returned segment_id. Use sections and segment_types to filter the response.

sections.description: Optional: filter which sections to include in the response. Values: 'segments', 'travelers'. Default: all sections.

segment_types.description: Optional: filter segments by type. Values: Flight, Lodging, CarRental, Train, Transfer, Ferry, EventTicket, Parking, Activity, Note, Poll. Default: all types.

trip_id.description: The unique identifier of the trip to fetch details for

name: trip_details
title: View trip itinerary
